title: skills(objectstack-upgrade): the upgrade skill says `os migrate meta` "writes nothing but `--out`", which `--write` (PR #22108) now makes incomplete
body:
Filed by the triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015, `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`) as the skills half of #9591's remainders (release `6044979380`). ⛔ Not a claim.

## What is now incomplete (read on `main` `f2a45db2ad`)

- `skills/objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md:62`: "# 1 · mechanical — replay the chain (reads the config, writes nothing but --out)".
- `skills/objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md:469`, the troubleshooting row: "Working as designed — the command writes nothing but `--out`."
- Both are true of the default invocation. Since PR #22108 (`a959493cdf`), `os migrate meta --write` also rewrites authored sources. An AI author reading the skill is never told that the flag exists.

## Direction

- Name `--write` at both sites. It writes only the sites it can prove, and lists every other site with a refusal kind. It restores every file and exits 1 on any disagreement.
- Say the default run still only lists.
- Keep the skill line ratchet: net 0 lines where the ratchet requires it.
- Word it consistently with the retirement sentence that #9591 restores in `packages/spec/src/shared/retired-key.ts` (spec lane). Neither waits on the other.

## Landing

`skills/**` is Tier H. The PR lands on an authorized approval or the maintainer's hand.

`Clause-②: no`. No changeset (skill text).

Dedupe: `objectstack-upgrade skill migrate meta writes nothing but --out` · `--write codemod skill text`.
